_published_faq.name: How do I add TUI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TUI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://anthropic-app-mcp-apps.prod.fos.tui/fos-mcp-app-anthropic-prod/mcp/v2.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TUI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TUI provides these MCP tools: search_accommodation_only_v2 and search_experience_v2.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TUI?
